name: cache-disk-gc
title: dsh-find-ideas: sweep expired and oversized disk cache entries
description: Nothing in src/ ever deletes a cache file. Add an opportunistic sweep after cacheSet, at most once per process per hour: drop .json older than 24h, drop *.tmp-* older than 10min, and evict oldest-first when the directory exceeds 64 MB. Sweep failures must never fail cacheSet.
creator: Tianyao2003
